Class StartFlowInterviewQueueable

public inherited sharing class StartFlowInterviewQueueable
implements Queueable, Finalizer

Queueable job that starts one or more Flow interviews asynchronously. Accepts a map of Flow API names to their input parameters and executes them sequentially by chaining queueable jobs. Each execution starts one Flow interview, then the Finalizer callback enqueues the remaining flows for the next execution. Errors are logged via ErrorUtils. Called via Sys.enqueueFlow() and FlowUtils.
